meta.source: Extracted from ElevatedLivesInc/nEXTrIGHTtHING (mission-control.html, fellowship-hall-meetings.html, tenant-config.js) and evolved into the Rein N' Solutions parent system.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Cool, navy-biased neutral. Never warm cream.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, inputs sitting on paper.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells, code blocks, table headers.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper and surface. 15:1+ both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, stat labels. 6.4:1 light, 8:1 dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Decorative only, never the only cue.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3:1 against surface).

tokens.name: rein-navy
tokens.usage: Brand field. Header bands, primary button fill in light theme. Inherited from NRT --navy #1a2744, deepened.

tokens.name: rein-navy-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest brand field, the Mission Control ground.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text on rein-navy. 14:1.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The signal colour: primary action, the one number that matters, focus ring. Inherited from NRT --sand #c9a96e, made more saturated. Fill only in light theme (text uses brass-ink).

tokens.name: brass-ink
tokens.usage: Brass used as text or icon on paper. 5.7:1 light.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text on a brass fill. 7.9:1 / 9.3:1.

tokens.name: brass-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet brass wash behind quick actions and selected rows.

tokens.name: iris
tokens.usage: Elevated Lives sub-brand and the walled/sensitive lane (clinical, private data). Inherited from NRT --lav #c9b6f0. Never used for Rein N' Solutions sales calls-to-action.

tokens.name: iris-tint
tokens.usage: Background for walled sections and Elevated Lives panels.

tokens.name: hot
tokens.usage: Needs attention today: overdue, at risk, failing. Pair with an icon or label.

tokens.name: hot-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind a hot alert.

tokens.name: warm
tokens.usage: Coming up soon: due this week, expiring in 30 days.

tokens.name: warm-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind a warm alert.

tokens.name: calm
tokens.usage: All clear, paid, live, delivered.

tokens.name: calm-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind a calm alert.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: hero headline, gig cover headline.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and tile headings, package names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We build the system, then we hand you the reins.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section eyebrows. Inherited from NRT .sec.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The big number on a stat tile. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips, between stat number and label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between quick-action buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner gap; minimum page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between tiles.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major bands.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, status badges (NRT .pill).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, alerts (NRT .alert).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Tiles and package cards (NRT .tile).

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hover state of a tile you can click. Resting tiles use a border, not a shadow.
